start_demo_ui_server: start the demo UI server as a separate subprocess using python server.py
stop_demo_ui_server: stop the demo UI server by finding and killing the python server.py process
create_DemoChat_instance: create a DemoChat instance with a log file path to manage chat logs as JSON
DemoChat_input: poll the chat log file for new entries and return new message content as a string
DemoChat_output: write a message with a role and timestamp to the chat log JSON file
